# wordpress — 2018 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=9, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 243 wordpress CVEs of 2018 are in `data/cve/vendors/wordpress/2018.jsonl`.

### CVE-2018-3810
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2018-01-01 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 43420: WordPress Plugin Smart Google Code Inserter < 3.5 - Authentication Bypass / SQL Injection (webapps/php, 2018-01-03, verified=1)

Authentication Bypass vulnerability in the Oturia Smart Google Code Inserter plugin before 3.5 for WordPress allows unauthenticated attackers to insert arbitrary JavaScript or HTML code (via the sgcgoogleanalytic parameter) that runs on all pages served by WordPress. The saveGoogleCode() function in smartgooglecode.php does not check if the current request is made by an authorized user, thus allowing any unauthenticated user to successfully update the inserted code.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

References:
- https://wordpress.org/plugins/smart-google-code-inserter/#developers [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://limbenjamin.com/articles/smart-google-code-inserter-auth-bypass.html [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://wpvulndb.com/vulnerabilities/8987 [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/43420/ [exploit,x_refsource_EXPLOIT-DB]

### CVE-2018-3811
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2018-01-01 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 43420: WordPress Plugin Smart Google Code Inserter < 3.5 - Authentication Bypass / SQL Injection (webapps/php, 2018-01-03, verified=1)

SQL Injection vulnerability in the Oturia Smart Google Code Inserter plugin before 3.5 for WordPress allows unauthenticated attackers to execute SQL queries in the context of the web server. The saveGoogleAdWords() function in smartgooglecode.php did not use prepared statements and did not sanitize the $_POST["oId"] variable before passing it as input into the SQL query.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

References:

### CVE-2018-25105 — File Manager <= 3.0 - Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload/Download
- Assigner: Wordfence | Published: 2024-10-16 | Updated: 2026-04-08 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-862 CWE-862 Missing Authorization
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

The  File Manager plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass due to a missing capability check in the /inc/root.php file in versions up to, and including, 3.0. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to download arbitrary files from the server and upload arbitrary files that can be used for remote code execution.

Affected:
- mndpsingh287 / File Manager: affected 0 <=3.0 (semver)
- mndpsingh287 / file_manager: affected 0 <=3.0 (semver)
